steps.description: Push the head (1) onto the stack. A child gets pushed before its owner's own next, so popping it splices it in immediately rather than leaving it for later.
1 becomes the head of the flattened list.
1's own next (2) still needs visiting — push it for later.
2's own next (3) still needs visiting — push it for later.
3's own next (4) still needs visiting — push it for later.
3 has a child list starting at 7 — push it so it is processed before 3's own next.
7's own next (8) still needs visiting — push it for later.
8's own next (9) still needs visiting — push it for later.
8 has a child list starting at 11 — push it so it is processed before 8's own next.
11's own next (12) still needs visiting — push it for later.
9's own next (10) still needs visiting — push it for later.
4's own next (5) still needs visiting — push it for later.
5's own next (6) still needs visiting — push it for later.
Stack empty — flattening complete. Final order: 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 7 -> 8 -> 11 -> 12 -> 9 -> 10 -> 4 -> 5 -> 6.
